data.name: srcxl.btn.template_hint
data.value: Download a blank Excel template (one worksheet = one device)

data.name: srcxl.btn.export_hint
data.value: Export the current configuration to Excel (edit and re-import; exporting first is recommended)

data.name: srcxl.btn.import_hint
data.value: Upload .xlsx / .xlsm; preview the differences before anything is written

data.name: srcxl.preview.hint
data.value: Below is the comparison against the existing configuration. Nothing has been written yet. Tick the items to import / delete, then click "Confirm Import".

data.name: srcxl.preview.delete_candidates
data.value: Delete candidates (previously imported from this workbook, missing this time)

data.name: srcxl.preview.delete_candidates_hint
data.value: Ticked by default; untick to keep. Delete = the Engine stops polling and the config file moves to _deleted; DB rows and history are kept.

data.name: srcxl.preview.others
data.value: Other existing configs not in this workbook

data.name: srcxl.preview.others_hint
data.value: Configs from other panels or placed manually; not deleted unless you tick them.

data.name: srcxl.sidshift.warning
data.value: Some worksheets insert, delete or reorder points in the middle. SIDs shift from that point on: history trends, alarm rules, calc points, controls and ScadaPage bindings will point at the wrong tags. Acceptable during commissioning; double-check after go-live.

data.name: srcxl.sidshift.ack
data.value: I understand history and control mappings will be misaligned; overwrite anyway

data.name: srcxl.detail.rename_hint
data.value: Points are identical to delete candidate "{from}"; this looks like a renamed worksheet. A new device (new CoordinatorId) will be created and history will not carry over once the old one is deleted

data.name: srcxl.detail.sid_shift
data.value: SID shift from point #{index} (high risk, extra confirmation required)

data.name: srcxl.detail.tail_removed
data.value: {count} point(s) removed at the tail (their SID history becomes orphaned)

data.name: srcxl.msg.no_selectable_errors
data.value: Nothing can be imported: {count} worksheet(s) have errors (checkboxes are locked). Fix the Excel file per the red notes in the "Detail" column (e.g. fill in the IP, add at least one point) and upload again.

data.name: srcxl.msg.no_selectable_unchanged
data.value: Nothing to import or delete: every worksheet matches the existing configuration.

data.name: srcxl.confirm.overwrite_list
data.value: The following {count} device config(s) will be overwritten:

data.name: srcxl.confirm.delete_list
data.value: The following {count} config(s) will be deleted:

data.name: srcxl.confirm.delete_note
data.value: After deletion the Engine stops polling; the config file is backed up in _deleted, DB rows and history are kept. Re-import a worksheet with the same name to restore.

data.name: srcxl.msg.waiting_engine
data.value: Configuration written; waiting for the Engine to load ({count} remaining)…
